title: Connection Pools & Transactions
objectives: Size and health-check a connection pool
Place transaction boundaries in the service layer

examples.name: tx_boundary.rs

exercise.prompt: Pick pool settings: "pool size 2 for 50 workers" (starvation), "pool size = workers, idle timeout 5m" (healthy), "no max lifetime on cloud DB" (stale connections), "checkout connection while calling a slow API" (pool exhaustion).
hints: Pools are sized for concurrency, not total users.
Never hold a DB connection across slow I/O.

options: the service use-case that defines the atomic operation
questions.explanation: The use-case knows what "all or nothing" means; repos participate in the tx.

questions.prompt: The danger of holding a lock/connection across an await is…
options: starving the pool and blocking other requests
questions.explanation: Slow I/O while holding a connection multiplies pool pressure.
